snippet.title: Runeward Online - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
BLAST, CAST & DODGE THROUGH ONLINE BULLET HELL!
📜 WISHLIST NOW! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4529850/Runeward_Online/
__________________

Free-to-play online RPG meets relentless bullet hell. Blast, cast, and dodge as
you chase rare loot, evolve your class, and bend the rules with game-breaking
runes and pets. Squad up with players worldwide while delving into
unforgiving dungeons and building your character, one drop at a time.

__________________

🟪 JOIN THE DISCORD https://discord.com/invite/azEHxxKwfY
🟦 SUPPORT ON PATREON https://www.patreon.com/c/RunewardOnline
📢 PRESS KIT: https://runeward.online/presskit

Developed with lots of love, over a span of multiple years.
This marks another step toward bringing Runeward to life.

MUSIC: ''Core'' by DEgITx - degitx.com - CC BY 4.0
